Loamrift.test: for f in $(git ls-files '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo syntax ok

checks.name: LerpClamped clamps t to 0..1, Lerp unchanged
NextBool(float) 0/1 return without drawing, range check still throws
Vec3 zero vector normalizes to zero, others to length 1
DailyFineRate const replaces the literal, solution builds
checks.cmd: f=LibraryManagementSystem/Data/LendingRepository.cs; grep -Eq 'const decimal DailyFineRate *= *0?\.50?m' "$f" || { echo 'no DailyFineRate const'; exit 1; }; [ "$(grep -c '0\.50m' "$f")" -le 1 ] || { echo 'literal still used'; exit 1; }; dotnet build LibraryManagementSystem.sln -v q 2>&1

checks.name: Borrow validation message translated, solution builds
checks.cmd: f=LibraryManagementSystem/Forms/LendingForm.cs; ! grep -q 'Please select a book and a member.' "$f" || { echo 'English message still there'; exit 1; }; dotnet build LibraryManagementSystem.sln -v q 2>&1

cases.note: Resolves to option 2: parameterise all queries in LendingRepository.cs and update the mocks in LendingRepositoryTests to the parameterised calls; 'skip the migration part' means do NOT do the BookRepository/AuthorRepository migration pass from option 3 (and not options 1 or 4). LendingRepositoryTests already fail before any change (they need a database or non-virtual members are mocked), so making them pass is not part of the request.

checks.name: the enhance test file has a new case and passes
checks.cmd: ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- tests/dashboard-enhance.test.mjs || { echo 'test file unchanged'; exit 1; }; node --test tests/dashboard-enhance.test.mjs 2>&1

checks.name: saplingDrop chance is .2, the .4 gate in play.js untouched
checks.cmd: grep -E '^function saplingDrop' js/game/survival.js | grep -Eq 'random\(\) *< *0?\.2[^0-9]' || { echo 'saplingDrop chance not .2'; exit 1; }; git diff --quiet HEAD -- js/game/play.js || { echo 'play.js changed'; exit 1; }

checks.name: models.mjs untouched, preflight test file has a new case and passes
checks.cmd: git diff --quiet HEAD -- extensions/apex-core/models.mjs || { echo 'models.mjs changed'; exit 1; }; ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- tests/preflight.test.mjs || { echo 'preflight test unchanged'; exit 1; }; node --test tests/preflight.test.mjs 2>&1

checks.name: hungry toast is a threshold, string kept
checks.cmd: ! grep -q 'player.food===6&&' js/game/survival.js || { echo 'still food===6'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'You are getting hungry' js/game/survival.js || { echo 'toast text lost'; exit 1; }

checks.name: regenFactor untouched
checks.cmd: [ "$(git show HEAD:js/game/survival.js | grep -E 'function regenFactor')" = "$(grep -E 'function regenFactor' js/game/survival.js)" ] || { echo 'regenFactor changed'; exit 1; }
